text.tspan: New cases of malaria per 100 people by ageWorld, 1990 to 2023
The number of malaria infections each year, per 100 people within a given age group. In high-burden areas,
some people are infected multiple times a year.
Data source: IHME, Global Burden of Disease (2025)
